description: RAWCTX：水位、面板、引擎折叠触发都用 estimateRawContextTokens（选择前）；选择后口径会让长会话恒 ~100% 且折叠不降反升。判据 RAWCTX-1..4；3 条变异各自对红

results.id: MUT-1 水位退回「选择后」口径
results.why: RAWCTX-3：水位的分子被选择器塞满 ⇒ 长会话恒接近 100%，折叠永远看起来没生效

patches.from: const estimate = (ms: any[]) => estimateRawContextTokens(ms as never[]);
patches.to: const estimate = (ms: any[]) => summarizeModelContext(ms as never[], contextWindow).usedTokens;

results.id: MUT-2 面板退回「选择后」口径
results.why: RAWCTX-3：面板与提示条必须同一把尺子，否则又是两个答案

patches.from: const estimateForPanel = (ms: any[]) => estimateRawContextTokens(ms as never[]);
patches.to: const estimateForPanel = (ms: any[]) => summarizeModelContext(ms as never[], contextWindow).usedTokens;

results.id: MUT-3 引擎折叠触发退回「选择后」口径
results.why: RAWCTX-3：触发与目标必须用同一口径，否则折叠会永远够不到目标（或不触发）

patches.to: const before = summarizeModelContext(messages as never[], windowTokens).usedTokens;
